hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer views precise GBP conversions and partner rate comparisons to evaluate redemption value with absolute clarity.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer is evaluating 5,600 LBG coins and wishes to know their exact cash equivalent.
hypotheses.storyTension: Point abstractions and unclear redemption rates create hesitation and risk abandonment.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear, upfront GBP conversion and transparent partner comparisons enable confident decision-making.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clarity of reward value in monetary terms to enable confident redemption decisions.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer compares partner redemption options side-by-side without pressure, retaining complete autonomy.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer wants to explore redemption options across 3 connected brands without being rushed.
hypotheses.storyTension: High-pressure tactics or countdown timers cause negative response and abandonment.
hypotheses.customerResolution: A calm customer choice panel and side-by-side partner comparison support pressure-free selection.
